syllabus_topics: Regular languages, regular expressions and regular grammars
Concept of algorithm according to Turing
Discussion of the equivalence between Turing machines and families of boolean circuits
Complete problems for boolean circuit classes
assessment_rules: The final grade for the course will be calculated as the average of the four tests (MAP30) during the period. There will also be a resit exam where students can improve the grade of any one or more MAPs.
